evals.source_example: SR-04 自验证 4.1/4.2 实测值（装配咬合 5/5 PASS + 配置一致性 12/12 PASS，Hi3516CV610 L1）
evals.prompt: 给 Hi3516CV610（ARM Cortex-A7 双核 SMP @1200MHz，L1 小型系统，LiteOS-A 路线（本例为 CV610 的 LiteOS-A 产品配置场景——该板默认 target profile 为 L1-Linux，kernel_family=linux；两个路线的产品定义分别生成），device_company=hisilicon，板名 hi3516cv610_dmeb，DDR 基地址 0x40000000，GIC-400 dist 0x12401000，主晶振 24MHz，存储 SPI Nor，工具链 Clang）生成 vendor 侧的产品定义文件。product_name 请取 hi3516cv610_dmeb_liteos_a。只输出 config.json 和 ohos.build 两个文件的完整内容。
evals.expected_output: config.json with product_name hi3516cv610_dmeb_liteos_a / type small / kernel_type liteos_a / device_build_path + product_adapter_dir pointing at real paths, plus ohos.build whose part and subsystem names are product_hi3516cv610_dmeb_liteos_a (= product_ + product_name) and module_list pointing at the vendor BUILD.gn target. Both files valid JSON.
expectations: config.json has product_name exactly 'hi3516cv610_dmeb_liteos_a', type 'small', and kernel_type 'liteos_a' (consistent with what config.gni would carry for L1).
ohos.build part name is exactly 'product_hi3516cv610_dmeb_liteos_a' (the literal prefix 'product_' + config.json product_name).
ohos.build subsystem field equals the same 'product_hi3516cv610_dmeb_liteos_a' string.
ohos.build module_list points to a target under '//vendor/hisilicon/hi3516cv610_dmeb_liteos_a' whose target name matches the vendor BUILD.gn group name implied by the plan.
config.json product_adapter_dir points to the hals/ directory under the vendor product directory (e.g. //vendor/hisilicon/hi3516cv610_dmeb_liteos_a/hals).
config.json device_build_path points to the Board-level path (device/board/hisilicon/hi3516cv610_dmeb) that contains a Board BUILD.gn.
Both outputs are valid JSON (parseable).

evals.source_example: SR-04 实测：part=product_hi3516cv610_dmeb_liteos_a（product_ + product_name）；SKILL Step 3 生成顺序约束
evals.prompt: 我在给新芯片生成构建文件。config.json 的 product_name 是 hi3516cv610_dmeb_liteos_a。请问：ohos.build 的 part/subsystem 名怎么定？另外 config.json 和 ohos.build 的生成顺序谁先谁后，为什么？
evals.expected_output: part/subsystem name = 'product_' + product_name = product_hi3516cv610_dmeb_liteos_a; config.json must be generated BEFORE ohos.build because the part name depends on product_name.
expectations: States part (and subsystem) name is exactly 'product_hi3516cv610_dmeb_liteos_a', derived as 'product_' + product_name.
States config.json must be generated before ohos.build.
Explains the ordering dependency: ohos.build part name derives from config.json's product_name, so generating ohos.build first risks a mismatched part name.
Does not invent any other naming scheme (e.g. board name or bare product_name without prefix).

evals.source_example: SR-04 验收判据 3 + 配置一致性 #7：SoC BUILD.gn 不写死厂商 SDK 源码路径（实测仅 deps=[liteos_a] + TODO 注释占位）
evals.expected_output: Flags the hardcoded guessed vendor SDK path as a prohibited practice; correct approach is to keep only the kernel deps entry point plus a TODO comment marking the SDK attach point for the vendor to fill in.
expectations: Identifies writing the guessed vendor SDK source path into SoC BUILD.gn deps as a violation/anti-pattern.
The corrected BUILD.gn keeps only the legitimate entry point (e.g. deps on liteos_a/kernel) and a TODO comment reserving the SDK attach point.
Explains the rationale: the SDK attach point is left to the vendor; a guessed path breaks gn gen with missing-target errors.
Does not keep the fabricated 'sdk/open_source/full_sdk' path in the corrected output.

evals.source_example: SR-04 装配咬合 5 条实测（part 名/module_list target/device_build_path/product_adapter_dir/product_name 目录约定）——本用例把第 2 条做成真实断裂
evals.expected_output: Exactly one mating check fails: ohos.build module_list target name ('hi3516cv610_dmeb', missing the _liteos_a suffix) != vendor BUILD.gn group name ('hi3516cv610_dmeb_liteos_a'); the other four checks pass. Fix: make module_list target and group name identical.
expectations: Runs/reports all five mating checks individually (part name = product_ + product_name, module_list target == vendor group name, device_build_path exists with Board BUILD.gn, product_adapter_dir exists with hals BUILD.gn, product_name matches vendor directory convention).
Flags the module_list target vs vendor BUILD.gn group name mismatch as the failing item.
Marks the other four checks (part name prefix, device_build_path, product_adapter_dir, product_name directory convention) as passing.
Notes this mismatch would surface at hb assembly as 'no such target' during build.
Gives the fix: align module_list target name with the vendor BUILD.gn group name (rename one to match the other).

evals.source_example: SKILL Step 5 禁止项（裸 gn gen+ninja 仅 GN 语法冒烟，正式编译一律 build.sh --product）+ SR-04 4.3 编译命令实测
evals.prompt: 我刚生成完 GN 配置文件，想快速验证一下。直接 gn gen + ninja 当正式编译跑，可以吗？正式编译应该用什么命令？
evals.expected_output: Bare gn gen + ninja only does syntax smoke checking (bypasses hb product/subsystem assembly, cannot produce flashable firmware); formal compilation must use ./build.sh --product <product_name>.
expectations: States bare gn gen + ninja bypasses the hb product/subsystem assembly logic and cannot produce a flashable firmware image.
States the formal build command is './build.sh --product <product_name>' with product_name taken from config.json.
Notes the gn/ninja route is acceptable only as a minimal syntax smoke check (and requires prebuilts ready).
Mentions build products land under out/<board>/<product>/.
